target.title: fix(ui): prevent unsafe custodian nudge answers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes issues where Custodian users could accidentally submit a canned diagnostic nudge as the answer to a sensitive hosted-wizard prompt, lose all later nudges after a rejected request, keep seeing a stale incident after health recovered, or have a card's Skip action rejected by a closed wizard step and repeated.

Before this change:

1. Open a sensitive hosted-wizard prompt, then click an existing health nudge. The nudge text is masked and sent as the prompt's credential value.
2. Reject a nudge request. The visit is marked as having consumed its nudge even though nothing was dispatched.
3. Publish a healthy snapshot, or a newer equal-severity incident. A stale nudge remains visible.
4. Click Skip for a closed hosted-wizard select question. The UI label is submitted as an unparseable answer and the mandatory question repeats.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Custodian now keeps event-nudge delivery separate from sensitive wizard input: nudges are disabled during sensitive prompts, consumed only after successful dispatch, and reconciled against the latest authoritative health snapshot without overwriting newer state during an in-flight request. Closed wizard questions submit the bridge's accepted `cancel` token while retaining the user-facing Skip label in the transcript.

The reconciliation helper lives with event classification so the page keeps one explicit state transition boundary. Freeform questions retain their existing Skip-label behavior.

## User Impact

Custodian nudges can no longer become credential answers. Failed sends remain retryable, recovered or superseded incidents update immediately, and Skip now advances closed hosted-wizard questions instead of repeating them.

## Evidence

- Fail-before regression coverage reproduced all four defects: sensitive nudge dispatch, permanent consumption after rejection, stale health state, and the unparseable Skip payload.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/custodian` passes all 47 tests across 6 files, including request payload and rendered-control assertions.
- Blacksmith Testbox run passed `pnpm tsgo`, `pnpm check:test-types`, and `pnpm deadcode:exports`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29689647653
- Targeted oxlint, formatting, and `git diff --check` pass on the final tree.
- Fresh branch autoreview against `origin/main` reported no actionable findings.
- This PR is AI-assisted. I reviewed the complete implementation, wizard answer contract, and regression tests.
